skill_name: Explain why GPT-3 is more useful than other language models.
workflow: GPT-3 has a number of advantages over other language models. First, GPT-3 is larger and more powerful than other language models due to its deep neural network and 175 billion parameters. This makes GPT-3 capable of accurately predicting words from a much larger context than other language models. Second, GPT-3 can generate more natural and accurate text, making it easier for people to understand.
